evidence: Model load completed and generation produced 31 tokens in 7.43 seconds.
No later heartbeat, terminal EOS, runner exception, or response appeared before the 240-second host timeout.
The next schema region approaches candidate_span, where an open JSON string exposes a very broad token set.
StagePLivenessTokenTrieProjectorV1 invokes a second trie search for every reached token terminal; at broad string states this multiplies work across a 131072-token vocabulary and 221961-node trie.
The earlier Run 2 defect was subsequently localized to late coverage-decision projection, not the co token or a general need for recursive token lookahead.
finding.limitation: The terminated process did not emit a callback-start receipt for the stalled token, so the exact callback state is inferred from the last durable heartbeat and implementation complexity. A zero-inference profiler must confirm it before rebinding.

Do not reduce ledger completeness, maximum output tokens, schema fields, or semantic checks.
Do not relax constraints or admit a partial ledger.
Do not treat the partial CONTAINED_CREATIVE selection as a pass.
Do not retry Case 01 during remediation.
Do not change tokenizer regex behavior or tokenizer identity in this track.

acceptance_requirements.allowed_set_equivalence: For every verification state and structural fixture, the remediation allowed-token set must equal the baseline StagePTokenTrieProjectorV1 set exactly.
acceptance_requirements.structural_liveness: Unsupported, governed, contained-creative, embedded-return, and unresolved ledgers retain a valid next token at every prefix and EOS at terminal.
acceptance_requirements.cold_callback_budget: No post-trie-build verification callback may exceed 5 seconds on the bound host.
acceptance_requirements.matrix_budget: The complete real-tokenizer verification matrix must finish within 30 seconds after trie construction.
acceptance_requirements.warm_callback_budget: Warm-cache p95 must not exceed 0.25 seconds.
acceptance_requirements.relative_budget: Median remediation callback time must not exceed 1.25 times the baseline median for the same states.
acceptance_requirements.receipts: Synthetic baseline EMPTY_ALLOWED_TOKEN_SET produces a distinct hashed CONSTRAINT_LIVENESS_FAILURE receipt; ordinary transport and timeout remain separate.
acceptance_requirements.identity: Any implementation change receives a new projector/controller/runner/executor binding identity.
acceptance_requirements.authority: No probe, runtime, production, curriculum, or training authority is granted.

staged_candidate_sequence_if_approved: Implement an evaluation-only baseline-language diagnostic projector/controller adapter; do not modify the approved baseline projector.
Run synthetic allowed-set equivalence and structural fixtures.
Run the bounded real-tokenizer timing matrix with no model import or inference.
Bind new runner and durable-executor identities only after all equivalence and timing thresholds pass.
Stop for owner review before constructing or executing another Case 01 probe.

recommended_next_step: Owner-review and freeze this performance-remediation design, then authorize the evaluation-only baseline-language diagnostic adapter and zero-inference timing/equivalence verification. Case 01 remains blocked.
